components.name: announce
components.description: End the call: read back a deterministic summary, then let the model close.

properties.name: say
properties.description: Spoken verbatim before the model's closing turn. Supports ${session_var} interpolation, so a factual summary is deterministic rather than recalled by the model.

properties.name: then
properties.description: What the model should say to close, in English.

examples.say: To summarise ${customer_name}, you are booked for ${slot_display}.
examples.then: Thank them, wish them a good day, and say goodbye.

components.name: branch
components.description: Route the call on what the customer said — a yes/no gate, a three-way close, which objection was raised. The outcomes and where each one goes are authored data, so this component declares no exits of its own.

properties.name: ask
properties.description: What the model must determine, in English.

properties.name: say
properties.description: Optional line spoken verbatim before the model's turn. Set it when the question must be worded exactly; leave it out when the branch reads an answer the customer has already given.

properties.name: choices
properties.description: Outcome name -> when it applies and which node it goes to.

properties.name: sets
properties.description: Session variable to record the chosen outcome in.

examples.ask: whether the customer agreed to continue the call now

no.describe: They declined or asked not to be called.

components.name: converse
components.description: Have a free-form exchange with the customer to accomplish one stated objective, then continue. Use when no more specific component fits.

properties.name: task
properties.description: What the model should accomplish in this turn, in English.

properties.name: say
properties.description: Optional opening line, spoken verbatim before the model's turn. Set it when the wording must be exact; leave it out to let the model open.

properties.name: collect
properties.description: Values this turn must come away with. Each becomes a function parameter; a missing required one re-asks with its authored line instead of letting the flow move on incomplete.

properties.name: max_attempts
properties.description: How many times the customer may fail to supply a required value before the `exhausted` exit is taken.

exits.name: exhausted
exits.description: The customer did not supply a required value within max_attempts. Only reachable when the step collects something required.

examples.task: Find out briefly why the caller is contacting us, and confirm you understood.
Ask what size they need and confirm it back.

collect.name: size
collect.describe: The size the customer asked for.

components.name: inform
components.description: Tell the customer something and wait for them to acknowledge before continuing. There is nothing to extract.

properties.name: say
properties.description: What to tell the customer, spoken verbatim.

examples.say: Please keep the area clear before the visit. Is that clear?

components.name: transfer
components.description: Hand the call to a human on another phone and end the agent's part. The caller hears one authored line, then the carrier moves the leg; whatever that number does with the call is its own business. Terminal — nothing runs after it and the conversation does not come back.

properties.name: say
properties.description: Spoken verbatim before the handover, in the flow's language. Required: a caller moved to a ringing phone with no warning thinks they were cut off.

properties.name: to
properties.description: The human's number in E.164 (+972...). Validated at publish, because the alternative is a caller discovering it.

examples.say: I am putting you through to a colleague now, one moment.
